method: Read the latest 20 turns, selected the ten latest substantive recommendation-bearing final answers, excluding status-only answers, choice dialogs and the separate 23-package plan. Repeated recommendations are retained and cross-reconciled; they are not ten new tasks.

recommendations.exact_text:
Yes—your supplied **`0x501122…afe1b` pool remains our test target**.

Even with no active liquidity, we can add test liquidity **only on an isolated local fork**, then exercise activation, growth, harvesting and rebalancing. Public funds and the real pool remain untouched.

I clarified this in the Todo, roadmap, operator guide and memory, pushed as **`c8124e6f`**. The new current-version fork rehearsal remains pending; final production selection stays separate.

Updated and pushed to `main`: **`a4720ece`**.

- Reconciled Todo, findings and roadmap across **23 packages / 83 tasks**.
- Added an offline mint-transaction reviewer; **14 new focused checks passed**. No unchanged tests rerun.
- Prepared the OpenSea adaptation plan and investigated another VRF option.

**My recommendation:** pursue OpenSea’s supported integration, resolving signed-presale trust and exact pricing before changing contracts.

Contracts, websites and running services remain unchanged. Production qualification stays open.

[Full report](https://github.com/ABEF/AAA/blob/a4720ecef3e0b0d97a1d16f8032cf751cc8b16e5/reports/readiness-advance-20261120/REVIEW.md)

**We’re still in stages 1–2: resolving launch feasibility and completing missing proofs.** Several engineering subchecks are now finished, but we have not reached final release freeze, independent approval or production deployment.

The framework remains **23 acceptance packages covering 83 tasks**. The Todo currently records **35 done, 40 in progress, 7 todo and 1 excluded**. These counts are not a production-readiness percentage: broad tasks stay open until their remaining acceptance criteria pass.

| Area | Where we are now | What remains |
|---|---|---|
| **Prices and markets** | Expanded investigation to 95 native pool keys, additional routes and three v3 markets. | **You’ll select the final pool later.** Independent sources, publication, usable depth and complete routes remain unqualified. |
| **RPC, chain and fees** | Bounded read-only provider evidence exists. | Complete PoPL execution capacity, actual fees, provider acceptance, failover and finality qualification. |
| **Compiler and build** | **Current compiler-advisory applicability review completed.** No confirmed reachable defect requiring an upgrade was found. | Final artifact/configuration freeze, independent review and continued size compliance. |
| **Maximum workloads** | Added cold LP conversion and claim evidence on the controlled 1,000-NFT/two-position state. | One activation case still needs **476,135 less estimated gas**; broader full-normal workloads remain open. |
| **LP management** | Existing local lifecycle and maintenance evidence remains valid within its recorded scope. | Actual-market execution, expanded compositions and operating/manipulation qualification. |
| **Rewards and royalties** | Additional actual conversions, partial claims, transfers, faulty-currency and backing checks passed locally. | Actual currencies/routes, complete fees and deployed integration acceptance. |
| **Manual operations and recovery** | Added real-module construction/binding and separate authority checks. | Actual authority wallets, full operating recovery and production ceremonies. |
| **OpenSea, randomness and artwork** | Identified concrete OpenSea configuration and VRF compatibility questions; clarified artwork inventory. | Supported platform/provider arrangements, content publication and marketplace acceptance. |
| **Backend and history** | **Fixed two claim-planning bottlenecks.** Normal 26-pin backend validation now works on the tested 32-NFT/65-currency flow, including payouts. | Full 1,000-NFT normal workloads, production HTTP/provider acceptance and matching history/consumer adoption. |
| **Production wallet flow** | Current integration remains unsigned; shared signing remains Anvil-only. | An approved production submission approach for activation, growth and claims. |
| **Keeper and hosting** | Existing isolated interruption/recovery evidence remains scoped and preserved. | Real normal-loop operation, off-host recovery, alerts, funding and operating acceptance. |
| **Deployment and approval** | **Current F6 local construction passed:** 25 creations, 19 bindings and 39 instances. | Actual production deployment/readback, independent audit, sealing approval and launch approval. |

The strongest advances since that plan are **compiler review, real local construction, cold settlement/claim verification, and the backend fixes**. The maximum-state **11/12 activation result was already known** when that plan was written.

With pool selection deferred, **OpenSea/VRF compatibility and the remaining gas case can advance independently**.

[Current roadmap](https://github.com/ABEF/AAA/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md) · [Backend evidence](https://github.com/ABEF/AAA/blob/main/reports/full-claim-admission-20261120/REVIEW.md) · [Construction evidence](https://github.com/ABEF/AAA/blob/main/reports/f6-construction-20261120/REVIEW.md)

**Next: establish a workable real ETH/ZZZ market configuration.** The latest recorded market review still leaves this as a deployment blocker.

We should:

- Identify usable pools with sufficient liquidity in **both swap directions**.
- Validate independent spot-price references.
- Check complete activation/growth execution under the **3% cap**.
- Find a ZZZ-to-ETH reward route meeting the **1% conversion cap**.
- Record exact addresses, fees, depth and reasons for rejection.

This can start with read-only checks, without changing pools or sending transactions.

Separately, the maximum-state slow-ZZZ activation still needs **476,135 less estimated gas**. OpenSea compatibility, VRF, production RPC/fees and independent audit also remain open.

Next: **complete backend claim validation against the full contract graph**.

The latest claim run used **903 of 1,024 allowed RPC calls**, while replacing complete deployment validation with a test fixture. We still need to prove the full checks fit.

I recommend:

- Build a coherent, isolated local contract setup.
- Verify every contract, binding, lifecycle state and admitted currency.
- Confirm planning fits **25 seconds, 1,024 RPC calls and 12M gas with full padding**.
- Fix confirmed bottlenecks, reuse the passed accounting checks, and update Todo/operator guidance.

After that: address the remaining **476,135-gas reduction** needed for the slowest activation case.

**Next: qualify LP reward conversion and claims at maximum supported state.**

We should verify:

- ZZZ LP fees convert to ETH for the **same NFTs**, without mixing principal or reserves.
- Partial claims, transfers and failed currencies preserve exact entitlements.
- Cold claims fit the existing **12M budget**, with the planner splitting larger selections correctly.
- Receipts and remaining balances reconcile exactly.

This can proceed on an isolated local chain, reusing existing evidence. It would qualify accounting and batching; actual live conversion routes remain a separate blocker.

No cap increases or unchanged-suite reruns.

**Next: rehearse deployment and bindings for the current F6 contracts on a new isolated local chain.**

Earlier construction evidence predates F6, and the latest maximum-state campaign used mocked Access/Registry components.

We should verify:

- Actual constructors, Factory children and reciprocal bindings.
- Real governance, keeper and guardian permissions.
- Creation gas and unchanged size limits.
- Complete pre-seal readback, with unknown inputs still blocked.

This closes a concrete predeployment gap without waiting for external providers. Preserve existing Anvil state; no public deployment or sealing, and no unchanged test suites rerun.

Actual prices/routes and OpenSea/VRF compatibility remain parallel launch blockers.

Completed the first readiness pass. **Pushed to `main`: `2891f6b2`.**

- **Compiler:** assessed all eight current advisory variants. No confirmed reachable defect requiring an upgrade; seven new offline analysis checks passed.
- **Live markets:** the selected pool has zero active liquidity at the captured block. The larger venue fails the tested reverse swap. Independent pricing remains unqualified.
- **OpenSea/VRF:** identified concrete compatibility questions around OpenSea’s configuration flow and randomness providers’ request-expiry rules.
- **Fixed ZZZ:** current runtime matches the retrieved ERC20Burnable source; inspected creator references grant no token-management powers.
- **Documentation:** updated Todo, operator guidance, findings and memory; corrected artwork publication counts.

**Next priorities:** usable prices/routes and confirmed OpenSea/VRF support. Gate A remains incomplete.

[Full results and evidence](https://github.com/ABEF/AAA/blob/2891f6b29691449d6667d36b9c678a0746ce5d80/reports/readiness-gate-a-20261120/REVIEW.md)

Production code, safeguards and live environments are unchanged. No unchanged test suites were rerun.

On an isolated local chain:

- **1,000 NFTs, both LP positions and 64 royalty currencies.**
- ETH/ZZZ activation and growth with pending royalties, faulty currencies and different activation orders.
- Harvest, compound and rebalance with populated accounting.

Verify exact entitlements, incumbent protection, rollback and gas: **32M contributions with full 20% padding; 24M maintenance with 25% padding**. Reuse existing evidence and run only missing combinations.

Afterward, connect the website to the new bounded ownership pages.
